crossRefs.note: But if any widow has children or grandchildren, let them learn first to show piety toward their own family and to repay…
But if anyone doesn’t provide for his own, and especially his own household, he has denied the faith, and is worse than…
Honor widows who are widows indeed.
Now she who is a widow indeed and desolate, has her hope set on God, and continues in petitions and prayers night and…

translations.web: If any man or woman who believes has widows, let them relieve them, and don’t let the assembly be burdened, that it might relieve those who are widows indeed.
translations.bsb: If any believing woman has dependent widows, she must assist them and not allow the church to be burdened, so that it can help the widows who are truly in need.
translations.kjv: If any man or woman that believeth have widows, let them relieve them, and let ➔ not the church be charged; that it may relieve them that are widows indeed.
translations.asv: If any woman that believeth hath widows, let her relieve them, and let not the church be burdened; that it mat relieve them that are widows indeed.
